messages:
maria (support): Hey team — Customer 'AcmeCorp' hitting intermittent SSE disconnects and partial streams. Happens ~55s after idle; client reconnects and sometimes gets a 502. Using ALB -> nginx (ingress) -> Envoy sidecar -> app. Please advise repro + quick mitigation.

tyler (infra): Can you paste the minimal curl/browser repro and relevant headers? ALB idle timeout often trips if upstream timeouts longer.

maria (support): Repro steps from customer (condensed):
1) Open SSE to /v1/stream with header Authorization: Bearer <token>
2) Let idle for ~55s (no messages)
3) Server emits new event -> client sees partial chunk then connection closes.
Curl they used: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer XXX" https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream
```
Attached excerpt of server stdout: "[INFO] send event id=42
[INFO] wrote 128 bytes
[WARN] write failed: write tcp 10.0.1.5:43000->10.0.2.9:54321: write: connection reset by peer"

jamie (eng-runtime): Logs look like the downstream (ALB/nginx) is tearing the connection during a half-open idle window. What are ALB target group settings + ingress config? Also curious if Cloudflare is in front of ALB.

maria (support): Customer says ALB (internal) -> no Cloudflare. Target group has default deregistration delay, health checks OK. Ingress nginx config (provided):
```
proxy_buffering on;
proxy_read_timeout 60s;
proxy_send_timeout 60s;
keepalive_timeout 65s;
```
Envoy config (sidecar) has http_connection_manager idle_timeout: 30s (this stood out).

tyler (infra): Aha — Envoy idle_timeout 30s will close upstream connection if no bytes seen for 30s. ALB default idle timeout 60s, nginx keepalive 65s, so mismatch. Envoy closing upstream causes FIN towards app which then surfaces as a write error. That matches the 'partial chunk then reset' symptom. :thinking_face:

jamie (eng-runtime): Confirmed — streaming requires the entire chain to allow long idle windows or the app must send keepalive comments. Two immediate mitigations:
- Increase Envoy http_connection_manager idle_timeout >= ALB idle timeout (recommend >90s)
- Have app emit SSE comment heartbeats every 15-20s (": ping\n\n") to keep byte activity across proxies.

maria (support): Customer also mentioned billing spike due to reconnect loops and some 502s when requests hit a cold instance. They saw rate limits triggered. Should we propose short-term routing change or a config patch we can push to their dedicated cluster?

tyler (infra): For quick mitigation we can suggest: set envoy idle_timeout: 120s, nginx proxy_read_timeout: 120s, ALB idle timeout: 120s (all aligned). Also disable proxy_buffering for the SSE path: `proxy_buffering off;` and `chunked_transfer_encoding on;` to avoid buffering that hides keepalives.
We should also advise client-side exponential backoff and limiting reconnect rate to avoid billing/comms storm.

jamie (eng-runtime): Adding to that — if they can't change proxies immediately, we can enable application-level heartbeats. I'll draft a minimal patch for our examples repo showing how to send SSE pings from Node/Python. Also will add an FAQ blurb for this class of proxy-mismatch.

maria (support): I'll send these steps to the customer: 1) heartbeat in app, 2) set timeouts aligned, 3) turn off buffering on SSE path, 4) add backoff on client reconnects. I also created a support ticket INC-2026-459 and flagged edge-team for potential docs + console check that warns when dedicated clusters have mismatched timeouts.

alex (customer): Thanks folks. Quick Q: is there anything on our side in AWS target group settings that commonly causes truncation?

tyler (infra): Mostly the ALB idle timeout; sometimes deregistration_delay and slow draining cause midstream resets during deploys — but your symptom (55s) points to idle timeout or envoy. If you can share envoy listener config we can confirm. Also check that TCP keepalives aren't disabled at OS level.

maria (support): Follow-up action: jamie will add heartbeat example + docs (ETA 24h). tyler will draft suggested config snippet for ALB/nginx/envoy (ETA 8h). I'll update INC-2026-459 and propose a short-term support patch we can push if customer authorizes. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Note added to INC-2026-459: "Repro validated locally by simulating 30s envoy idle -> upstream close; see run 2026-03-16T14:25Z"

maria (support): Closing loop — customer applied heartbeat in app and increased envoy idle_timeout to 120s. No disconnects observed for 6+ hours and billing reconnections dropped. Will leave ticket open for a week then close. Great teamwork everyone! :party:
